thread:
sara_pm: hey team :wave: RetailChain asked for an on-prem/VPC pilot. they want a checklist + rough timeline to share with procurement. key asks: air-gapped option, HSM, SOC2 evidence, and predictable latency SLA. can we do a quick intake here?

jamal_se: thanks — can you paste the customer constraints? region, expected QPS, data residency limits?

sara_pm: they signed an nda. high level: EU-only, 50 reqs/sec peak for chat (short prompts), burst to 200 for holidays, want data never to leave their VPC. timeline: pilot in 8 weeks, production in 16 weeks if pilot ok.

liam_sales: procurement will push for a fixed term license + support. they also want HSM-backed keys and audit logs retained 2 years.

anika_sec: prelim security asks: KMS/HSM integration (FIPS), SCAP checklist, penetration test window, IDS/IPS rules, inbound ports locked down. need contact for their security team to exchange requirements.

todd_infra: from infra POV we need network layout, available VLANs/subnets, egress policy, and whether they allow NAT/gateway instances. also hardware constraints: do they want GPUs on-prem or in their cloud VPC?

sara_pm: they said "edge colo + cloud VPC" hybrid is possible. prefer cloud for GPUs but air-gap for PHI-like dataflows.

jamal_se: ok actionable checklist draft below — please react and add gaps. also blocked items that will affect schedule.

jamal_se: DEPENDENCIES & QUESTIONS:
- network: CIDR ranges, peering vs transit, required routes, egress proxies
- auth: SSO provider, SCIM, required roles, MFA enforcement
- secrets: KMS vs customer HSM, key rotation policy
- storage: S3-compatible endpoints or on-prem NFS? retention policy for logs/kv caches
- hardware: GPU types if on-prem, driver/kernel constraints, cuda/cuDNN versions
- images: container runtime (docker/runc/crun), allowed registries, image signing
- compliance: SOC2 artefacts needed, ISMS evidence, pen-test schedule
- monitoring: prometheus endpoints, agent policy, allowed ports to metrics stack
- backup & restore: RPO/RTO expectations, snapshot cadence

jamal_se: quick ports snippet to share with customer (feel free to copy):
```
# minimal egress for Redwood runtime
- 443 outbound to api.redwood-internal.example.com
- NTP (UDP 123) to their internal NTP pool
# internal ports between runtime nodes
- 3100 TCP (metrics)
- 50051 TCP (gRPC model servers)
```

anika_sec: add to checklist: HSM network isolation rules, certificate pinning, key escrow policy, and audit log integrity (immutable storage). also confirm they accept our SBOM for runtime binaries.

liam_sales: procurement note: ask for procurement SLA contact, PO lead time, and any legal redlines around export controls. we should surface this to legal now.

todd_infra: scheduling risk: if they require on-prem GPUs we need a site survey and rack/PDU specs — that can push pilot +4 weeks. if they allow cloud GPUs only, we can keep 8-week pilot.

sara_pm: decision tree for customer call:
- if HSM must be on-prem and GPUs on-prem -> schedule site survey immediately and move pilot to 12 weeks
- if HSM via cloud HSM and GPUs in cloud -> keep 8-week pilot (we prepare VPN/peering + IaC)

jamal_se: would like a single one-pager to send to their infra/security listing the minimums + optional add-ons. i'll draft after we confirm acceptance of our SBOM by their security.

anika_sec: i'll sync with legal for SOC2 artefacts we can share and prep a redacted pen-test summary to accelerate their review.

deploybot: deployment-checker: required iam roles missing: redwood_deploy, redwood_metrics_write — create before provisioning.

liam_sales: ok next steps: 1) sara to intro customer security/infra -> email today 2) jamal to draft one-pager checklist 3) anika/legal to confirm shareable artefacts 4) todd to prep site-survey template if needed.

sara_pm: doing 1) now. I'll cc everyone. any other blockers? :thinking_face:

jamal_se: none from me. I'll start the one-pager and include the port snippet + dependencies.

anika_sec: none. starting legal runbook items.

todd_infra: will draft site-survey; tagging potential delay flags in calendar.

sara_pm: great — thanks all. I'll update thread after customer intro. :memo:
